rationale: Adds a new presentation-only plan orientation workflow: per-space device choices, card/kiosk configuration and exact clockwise/counterclockwise quarter turns across Flat, 2.5D, editors, Static and PDF. Canonical space/layout storage and geometry are unchanged.

summary.ru: Поворот плана на 90° в обе стороны с запоминанием на устройстве, настройкой киоска и согласованными редакторами и экспортом.
summary.en: Turn the plan in either direction by 90°, with device-local choices, kiosk configuration and matching editors and exports.

golden.reason: New clockwise quarter-turn frame with horizontal device/room faces, a right value badge, plan-relative icon angle/decor text, sunlight and a lock opening.
New counterclockwise quarter-turn frame of the same canonical geometry and screen-facing overlays.
New explicit zero-side reference of the complete quarter-turn fixture; existing zero-angle scenes have no pixel-change allowance.
New 2.5D camera side with correct projected walls/openings and screen-up raised overlays.
New opposite 2.5D camera side; canonical physical geometry and sunlight are reused.
New fourth 2.5D side with projection/depth ordering and readable room/device faces.
